problems.issue: incomplete companion list: translation en locale omitted
problems.detail: The row moves translation pt-BR from 'Tem muita gente nesta estação apertada.' to 'Tem muita gente na estação apertada.', and its own why gives the reason: the Japanese carries no demonstrative. The stored translation.en is 'There are a lot of people in this crowded station.' and still carries 'this'. The row's re-authoring list names only token position 2, particles[0] and the en locale of structure_explanation; it does not name translation.en. The file's own scope_note requires 'the en locale of any translation or explanation whose pt-BR moved', and rows aef805c4840d, cb6562f41e17 and 8cc2f196d1e9 all name 'the en locale of both translations'. Applying exactly what this row enumerates leaves pt-BR and en disagreeing about a demonstrative the new jp does not have. The six supplied values are correct; the applier must extend the list to translation.en. translation_literal.en ('At the cramped station, there are a lot of people.') is already correct under に and needs nothing.

The stored token is pos 'noun', pos_coarse 名詞, pos_fine 普通名詞, correct for 妹. 私 is tagged pos 'pronoun', pos_coarse 代名詞, pos_fine '*' everywhere else in this corpus, including sent:gen-cb6562f41e17 position 0, which is the very record this row cites as its precedent for 私 being vocab 690. Rows cb6562f41e17 and 8cc2f196d1e9 both list 'pos pronoun' explicitly when a pronoun moves, so this row is the outlier. Applying exactly what it enumerates leaves 私 mis-tagged as a common noun. The six supplied values are correct; the applier must extend token position 0 to pos, pos_coarse and pos_fine. role ('tópico') is correctly not listed, since 私は remains the topic.
